findings.text: Inverted condition installs default packages only on failure (EXIT_CODE -ne 0) instead of success; with NVM_UPGRADE_NPM unset and version already installed, default packages are never installed.
EXIT_CODE is uninitialized when NVM_UPGRADE_NPM is not 1, causing syntax error or unpredictable behavior in the [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ] comparison.
Reinstall-packages only runs when EXIT_CODE -ne 0 (failure); with --reinstall-packages-from flag on already-installed version, packages are not reinstalled on success.
Alias assignment only occurs when EXIT_CODE -ne 0 (failure); using --alias with already-installed version fails to set the alias on success.
Empty default-packages (no packages configured) causes nvm_install_default_packages to return error code instead of succeeding silently, breaking installs with no default-packages file.

4.reason: The code explicitly checks for empty DEFAULT_PACKAGES and returns early, so an empty default-packages file does not cause an error; it returns 0 (success) when nvm_get_default_packages succeeds with empty output.
